title: State midwifery law and birth attendant exemption
summary: On October 15, members voted unanimously to send the committee's letter backing midwifery legislation to legislators toward the end of November and to the women's caucus as soon as possible. The bill and the committee's past letters will be attached, and the vice chair will supply the women's caucus contact. Testifiers urged that the letter reach every state representative and senator after the November election and back three changes to midwifery law.
